answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 64 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a thread bet on surviving 64 epochs of grading, and every relic settlement recomputes the whisper schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
